inputs.utterance: create a calc to change activity owner title to numeric values

calculatedFieldFormula.formula: CASE [Activity Owner Title] WHEN 'Partner - Field' THEN 1 WHEN 'Commercial' THEN 2 WHEN 'Field' THEN 3 WHEN 'Public Sector' THEN 4 WHEN 'Channel' THEN 5 WHEN 'Partner - Inside' THEN 6 WHEN 'Enterprise' THEN 7 WHEN 'Inside' THEN 8 WHEN 'TSI' THEN 9 WHEN 'Needs Research' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
